sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Neurology reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 3. The compound donepezil was discussed with target ACHE in the context of Alzheimer disease. The example mutation is Y337A. A demonstration IC50 measurement of 244 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0003 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0003.
